away.summary: The Panthers are 2-2-2 and coming off a 5-3 loss to the Sabres. Akira Schmid is projected to start in goal after Jacob Markstrom exited early in that game with tightness. Key absences include Barkov, Marchand, and Gadjovich due to injury, with Balinskis scratched.

doubtful.detail: Game-time decision; if unable to play, Del Bel Belluz will make season debut

home.summary: The Blue Jackets are 2-2-0 and preparing to host the Panthers. Cam Talbot is projected to start for the second time in three games. The team will be without Fabbro, Provorov, Lundestrom, and Andrae due to injury or scratch, with Garland a game-time decision due to illness.
